sentences.text: This dinosaur grew to a length of approximately 3 meters.
The only known specimen consists of a partial left mandible and a fused scute, with the central bone section missing.
Richard Lydekker named the genus and species Sarcolestes in 1893, initially believing it was a theropod.
Sarcolestes belongs to the dinosaur class Ornithischia and is classified within the parent group Ankylosauria.
Franz Nopcsa classified it as a herbivorous stegosaurid in 1901, while Peter Galton later concluded it belongs to the nodosaurid family based on dentary similarity to Sauropelta.
Sarcolestes lived during the Middle Jurassic, approximately 162 million years ago in the Callovian stage in what is now Europe.
Some researchers have questioned the classification of Sarcolestes within Nodosauridae and even its validity as a distinct genus.
